note: Read 2026-11-03 on pravo.by (the National Legal Internet Portal; plain requests answered 403 and the text was read through a fetching service). Work: the Labour Code, art. 21 and art. 272: a labour contract from sixteen; from fourteen only with a parent's written consent, for light work or professional sport that harms neither health nor schooling (the list of light work set by the republican labour authority; not held); art. 22: a contract with anyone under fourteen is void. No article read makes an exception for cinema, theatre, circus or concerts, so performers below sixteen are held barred (my reading; the light work at fourteen isn't held, as elsewhere). Majority: null here; the person research's (research/sources/person/ages/BY.json) is read. The Civil Code, art. 20, read the same day, gives full capacity at eighteen too. Service: not read (the game doesn't read service).

sources.title: Трудовой кодекс Республики Беларусь (No. 296-З of 26 July 1999), arts. 21, 22 and 272, current text on the National Legal Internet Portal (pravo.by)
sources.said: Заключение трудового договора допускается с лицами, достигшими шестнадцати лет. ... С письменного согласия одного из родителей ... для выполнения легкой работы или занятия профессиональным спортом ... [art. 22, a contract void:] с лицом моложе четырнадцати лет
